title: Chapter 134
text:
Most players were busy with missions. Organized players were more purposeful, such as guilds and professional players. They planned their development path and grew steadily.

However, the Guild of Gods was in an awkward situation. Jupiter had thrown the daily affairs to the vice president, and he had not given up on the A-level mission. He had brought some people to look for the Germinal Organization's base, but to no avail. He had no choice but to pay attention to the forum to see if there were any players in contact with the Germinal Organization.

He found it. Andrea was the Germinal Organization's base camp. Players who landed in Andrea could easily join the Germinal Organization, but this was of no help to Jupiter.

The core members who had accepted the Class A mission were all in the Southern Continent, and Zero was most likely in the Southern Continent as well. It was impossible for Jupiter to bring people to the Andrea Continent. More importantly, they had no way to go to another continent.

In fact, they could take a cruise ship or a plane, but the current players had not come into contact with this level yet.

The most popular post on the forum was the battle scene recorded by the Big Horn Village players. Jupiter had not seen it before, but he was shocked when he opened it. Just as he was about to close the post, he suddenly noticed something. He quickly stopped playing and looked carefully. He finally confirmed that the attacked troops had the Germinal Organization's emblem.

God, I finally found the organization!

Jupiter almost burst into tears, but he suddenly realized that the troops had been wiped out. His expression changed, and he quickly looked at the content of the post. Unfortunately, the original poster did not mention the details except for the video.

Jupiter desperately wanted to know what had happened, so he asked the members to contact the players in Big Horn Village.

The guild was very efficient. He quickly found out that the attacked troops were the Germinal Organization's evacuating troops. He was stunned.

"Evacuate? Why evacuate? Where are they evacuating from? How big is the evacuation? One troop or many? "

Jupiter swallowed and suddenly had a very bad feeling. He felt that he would not be able to return to the Germinal Organization in a short time.

This A-level mission was so f * cked up. Jupiter's balls were about to break. The mission had not even started, and the organization that issued the mission had already left. What was there to play?

…

In the evening, the setting sun was as red as blood. In the evening sky, the outlines of a few moons could be seen.

In the forest outside Big Horn Village, Mad Blade Angry Sword walked in the forest with his head down. He was devastated that he had missed Black Phantom.

"I must find him."

Mad Blade Furious Sword quickly shook off his dejected mood. He was very determined as he talked to himself to encourage himself.

"Are you looking for me?" Suddenly, someone spoke.

Mad Blade raised his head and saw a truck parked in front of him. A man in black was waiting beside the truck and staring at him. It was Black Phantom!

Mad Blade's Fury Sword quivered in excitement.

Every cloud has a silver lining!

"You, you … have we met before?" Mad Blade stammered. He was not completely sure that Black Phantom was Han Xiao, so he was very nervous. After asking the question, he felt like every second was like years, like he was waiting for the verdict.

Han Xiao narrowed his eyes and smiled. "What do you think?"

It was this familiar look! His eyes made one's blood run cold!

Mad Blade was ecstatic. He was sure that this person was Han Xiao!

Luckily, I didn't give up and finally found you! Thigh!

"Come with me." Han Xiao smiled faintly. He crossed his arms in front of his chest and tilted his head toward the truck. Mad Blade Furious Sword suppressed the joy in his heart and hurriedly got into the truck.

He did not care where Han Xiao was taking him. He just wanted to stay by Han Xiao's side … Okay, I know what you guys are thinking. This sentence is very appropriate, I know.

Han Xiao smiled. After spending some 'happy' days together, he naturally remembered Mad Blade Furious Sword. However, this was not the reason why he chose to bring Mad Blade Furious Sword. Mad Blade Furious Sword had a lot of potential and was worth a lot of effort to nurture. Furthermore, having a player by his side could be used as cannon fodder to help him take risks. After all, he would not die, so he could use him without any worries.

The next mission seemed to be able to use Mad Blade Furious Sword, so when Han Xiao noticed that Mad Blade Furious Sword was following him, he stopped and waited for him.

Mad Blade Furious Sword did not know that he was once again used as a lab rat. He was full of excitement as he sat in the truck and looked around. He remembered that during the closed beta, Han Xiao was clearly a member of the Stardragon Intelligence Agency. How did he become Black Phantom all of a sudden?

However, this was not important. As long as he could follow Han Xiao and continue to rely on him, Mad Blade Furious Sword would be satisfied.

"What are we going to do now?"

After the excitement passed, Mad Blade Furious Sword asked.

"Do something bad." Han Xiao took out his tablet and opened the map. He drew a circle on an area and threw it to Mad Blade Furious Sword.

Mad Blade Furious Sword glanced at it.

"Tedramira River, where is that?"

"A battlefield."

Han Xiao finished calmly, stepped on the accelerator, and the truck rushed out.

…

Tedramira River, a big river in the Southern Continent, connected to the sea. The river was wide and blue.

Under the night sky, a long line of lights cruised along the river. This was a huge fleet disguised as fishing boats. In fact, they were various warships of the Germinal Organization, equipped with various shipboard weapons, anti-detection jammers, machine gun interception arrays, and so on.

Due to the Six Nations' clean-up operation, the Germinal Organization's bases had begun to evacuate. A small number of important people took the air route, while most of the supplies, vehicles, and ordinary armed personnel took the water route. The evacuation operation had reached its end. This fleet was the last large fleet to evacuate from the Southern Continent. The outer layer of frigates guarded a large number of barges in the middle. The barges were full of vehicles and armed personnel of the ground forces.

The evacuation plan was to follow a branch of the Tedramira River out to sea and meet with the other ground forces near the estuary. The ground forces would board the ships. Both sides had a unified command. The person in charge was called Lin Yu, the person in charge of the Germinal Organization's largest base in the Southern Continent. He was currently the commander and was also in the fleet.

Lin Yu was a middle-aged man. He was also a combat capable executive officer. He was looking at the map with a serious face in the command room. There were many parts to the evacuation plan. The fleet and the ground forces had to ensure that they arrived near the estuary at the same time because the fleet could not stop.

During the evacuation, a large number of Stardragon and Hesla fighter jets were scouting. The fleet's whereabouts had been exposed, and everyone was in a state of panic.

Lin Yu was very clear that Hesla and Stardragon must have set up a trap near the estuary. The navy, air force, and ground forces that intercepted the fleet wanted to capture them all in one fell swoop.

However, from the beginning, Lin Yu was very clear that it was impossible to secretly evacuate. A fierce battle was unavoidable. Only by forcefully tearing apart the blockade line could they escape.

"As long as we follow the Tedramira River into the sea, we will be able to escape this nightmare. But don't hold on to the illusion that everything will be smooth sailing. Lads, we will encounter a premeditated ambush. Stardragon and Hesla's navy will do whatever it takes to sink us near the estuary!"

"I have been through thirteen big and small wars. Among you, maybe some of you are veterans like me, and some of you may be new recruits. However, our fates are the same. Break through the blockade, and you can survive. If you are intercepted, even if you are lucky enough to survive, you will face the indefinite imprisonment of Stardragon and Hesla, and you will never see the sun of freedom again!

"The Six Nations are all a bunch of hypocritical, treacherous villains. They talk about peace and freedom, but they initiate wars. Don't forget that your motherland was destroyed by the guns of the Six Nations. Never forget the hatred of blood!"

"We have no choice but to fight to the death!"

These were the words that Lin Yu said to his subordinates. The armed personnel on the ship knew that there was going to be a fierce battle ahead, and they were ready for battle.

There were many Germinal executive officers on the fleet, and Hella was among them. She was very worried about the upcoming battle. In her opinion, it was impossible for them to break through the blockade of Stardragon and Hesla's navy with just these armed ships.

Many people would die, and only a few would survive.

However, Commander Lin Yu seemed to have a plan in mind. Hella could only suppress the uneasiness in her heart and not show it. She was still an iceberg to the outside world.

In fact, to Hella, even if all the Germinal members on the fleet were to die, she would not frown. She hated the Germinal Organization, but if she wanted to survive, she could only rely on these Germinal soldiers.

Hella was very clear that her hands were stained with blood. She did not avoid this point. Self-blame and pity belonged to good people, and it was too extravagant for her. From the day she awakened her superpower, she knew that she could not be a good person.

The ruler of death was destined to have blood on her hands.

However, her sister Aurora was the opposite. She was an angel, and she used her love for the world to infect everyone who came into contact with her. If she had to talk about regret, she only regretted that she did not protect her sister well and fell into the hands of the Germinal Organization.

"No matter what, I have to live …"

Only by living and being useful could she reduce her sister's suffering.

Everyone who stood in her way was an enemy.
